leaves.name: heckeJ1DS
leaves.doc: aftate-fix2 (r16-det fold): the Hecke operators on J_1(N) over Q. For N >= 2, every model X of Diamond-Shurman's X_1(N)_alg with chosen generators (j_X, t_X) of K(X) = Q(j, f_1) (IsX1Gen: the integer relations of (j_X, t_X) are those of (j(tau), f_1(tau)), f_1 = T5Glue.weber <1,tau> (1/N)), every rational point P0 and every Jacobian (J, aj) (Albanese property): there are endomorphisms T_p (every prime p) and <d> (d in (Z/N)^*) of J over Q acting on degree-0 divisor classes of the points x_tau (AtTau: the complex point where every g in K(X) whose meromorphic function on H has a limit c at tau is regular with value c) by DS's double-coset formulas: T_p[x_tau] = sum_{j<p} [x_{(tau+j)/p}] + [x_{g(p tau)}] (last term for p not dividing N; g in SL_2(Z), N | c, d = p mod N), <d>[x_tau] = [x_{g tau}]. Dictionary audit (hecke-pin): IsHeckeT/IsDiamond pin T_p and <d> (AfTateLam.HeckePin.isHeckeT_unique, isDiamond_unique); hecke-glue proves both inputs X1TauPoints and ConstOnTauPoints (AfTateLam.HeckeGlue.x1TauPoints, constOnTauPoints), so the pinning holds with no hypothesis (AfTateLam.HeckeGlue.isHeckeT_unique', isDiamond_unique').
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Diamond-Shurman 6.3 Hecke operators on Div/Pic^0 of X_1(N) by double cosets, pp. 226-227, coset representatives Prop. 5.2.1 p. 171, 7.9 T_p and <d> defined over Q p. 300; AI-read by r16-close, no human reading)
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, A First Course in Modular Forms, GTM 228 (2005), 6.3 (pp. 226-227), Prop. 5.2.1 (p. 171), 7.9 (p. 300); Shimura 1971 7.2 (unread)

leaves.name: afShimura
leaves.doc: aftate-fix2 (r16-det fold): Shimura's A_f over Q. For a newform f in S_2(Gamma_1(N)) with nebentypus chi, N >= 2, X, (j_X, t_X), P0, (J, aj) as in heckeJ1DS and any T_p, <d> with DS's divisor action: K_f is a number field, and there are A, pi : J -> A and theta : K_f -> End^0(A) with IsAfQuotient (pi surjective, kills I_f J, universal among homomorphisms to abelian varieties killing I_f J; I_f = image of the kernel of T_p -> a_p(f), <d> -> chi(d) on the free algebra) and IsAfAction (theta(a_p) is the endomorphism induced by T_p, theta(chi(d)) the one induced by <d>). Dictionary audit (hecke-pin): KillsIf kills exactly DS's I_f J (AfTateLam.HeckePin.killsIf_iff_IfDS_of_leaves, from ker(heckeJ) in ker(evF); inputs X1TauPoints, AbelJacobiX1; Eichler-integral glue proved; hecke-glue proves X1TauPoints, leaving AbelJacobiX1 only: AfTateLam.HeckeGlue.killsIf_iff_IfDS_of_abelJacobi); A_f unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with pi (isAfQuotient_unique, no input); theta unique (theta_unique, via a_n in Q(a_p, chi(d)), no input).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Shimura 1973 Thm 1: the Q-rational quotient A_f = J/I_f J with the coefficient-field action; read by the locator audit, row R16, pp. 526-527; DS Def. 6.6.3, Prop. 6.6.4 over C)
leaves.source: Shimura, On the factors of the jacobian variety of a modular function field, J. Math. Soc. Japan 25 (1973), Thm 1, pp. 526-527 (read by the locator audit, row R16); Diamond-Shurman GTM 228 (2005), Def. 6.6.3 (p. 241), Prop. 6.6.4 (p. 242) (AI-read by r16-close)

leaves.name: afCharpolyDS965
leaves.doc: r16-det: Diamond-Shurman Thm 9.6.5 at k = 2 for the Section 9.5 realization on A_f, over K_{f,lambda}, universal over A_f. For every (A, pi, theta) that is DS's A_f (afShimura's characterization, for any X, generators, P0, Jacobian and Hecke operators as in heckeJ1DS), every prime l and every place lambda | l of K_f: for p not dividing N l every arithmetic Frobenius sigma at p acting on V_lambda = K_lambda (x)_{Q_l (x) K_f} V_l(A) (rho_{f,lambda}, DS Exercise 9.5.2(a)) has characteristic polynomial X^2 - a_p X + chi(p) p over K_lambda. Statement = aftate-fix2's AfTateLam.AfTateDSLambda verbatim (AfTateLam.afCharpolyDS965_iff, Iff.rfl); it implies r16-close's glue AfDetLambda (AfTateLam.afDetLambda_of_ds965). Dictionary audit (hecke-pin): its IsHeckeT, IsDiamond, IsAfQuotient, IsAfAction hypotheses are about DS's T_p, <d>, A_f, theta (AfTateLam.HeckePin, as for afShimura/heckeJ1DS; hecke-glue: T_p, <d> pinned with no hypothesis, I_f modulo AbelJacobiX1 only). DS p. 393 (2016 p. 404): the identification of the Section 9.5 representation with 9.6.5's rho at k = 2 is the sentence two paragraphs after the theorem ('Section 9.5 constructed rho_{f,lambda} when k = 2 ...'); it asserts the identification, gives no proof.
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Diamond-Shurman Thm 9.6.5, 'the characteristic equation of rho_{f,lambda}(Frob_p) is x^2 - a_p x + chi(p) p^{k-1} = 0', at k = 2, with DS's identification on the same page that for k = 2 the representation is the Section 9.5 construction, whose characteristic equation Section 9.5 had not proved; AI-read by r16-det in the 2005 (p. 393) and 2016 (p. 404) printings, no human reading)
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, A First Course in Modular Forms, GTM 228 (2005), Theorem 9.6.5 and the paragraph after it, p. 393 (2016 fourth printing p. 404); rho_{f,lambda} and V_l(A_f) as in Lemma 9.5.3, Theorem 9.5.4, Exercise 9.5.2(a), pp. 389-391

leaves.name: igusaGL2DS
leaves.doc: x1-igusa: Igusa's theorem in its printed form, Gal(Q(j, E_j[N])/Q(j)) = GL_2(Z/N) for Diamond-Shurman's E_j : y^2 = 4x^3 - g x - g, g = 27j/(j-1728), j transcendental. For N >= 1, every basis e : (Z/N)^2 = E_j[N] over an algebraic closure of Q(j) and every g in GL_2(Z/N), some sigma in Aut(Q(j)bar/Q(j)) acts on E_j[N] as g in the basis e. Used through X1Igusa.x1PointsConjugate_of_igusaGL2DS (the dictionary IsX1Model -> IsX1AlgDS, aftate-or).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Diamond-Shurman Thm 7.6.3, Gal(Q(j,E_j[N])/Q(j)) = GL_2(Z/N), p. 290, with E_j of (7.12) p. 282; AI-read by r16-close, no human reading)
leaves.source: Diamond-Shurman, A First Course in Modular Forms, GTM 228 (2005), Theorem 7.6.3 (p. 290), universal curve (7.12) (p. 282); Igusa, Amer. J. Math. 81 (1959) (unread)
